question: The Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award 2022 was conferred upon Guru Niranjan Rout and Guru Ramahari Das for their contribution to the fields of ________ dance and music
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award 2022 was conferred upon **Guru Niranjan Rout and Guru Ramahari Das** for their contribution to the fields of **Odissi** dance and music.
 
• Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was a legendary exponent of Odissi dance, and his contributions significantly shaped and popularized this classical dance form.
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• The dance form is known for its fluid movements, sculpturesque poses, and intricate footwork, often depicting themes from Hindu mythology.
 
• Guru Niranjan Rout and Guru Ramahari Das have been instrumental in preserving and promoting the rich cultural heritage of Odissi through their dedicated work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award is an annual award presented by the Srjan (Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi Nrityabasa) to honor outstanding individuals in the fields of dance, music, theater, and cinema.
 
• Established in 1995, Srjan aims to promote and preserve the legacy of Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra and the classical dance form of Odissi.
 
• Recipients of this prestigious award are recognized for their exemplary contributions and dedication to the performing arts.
 
• The award ceremony is a significant cultural event, celebrating the rich artistic traditions and encouraging future generations to pursue excellence in the arts.
